subject.title: fix(gateway): keep hot reload subsystems consistent during channel deferral

question: Should head adf1b9d56329398ca029276d55820120cbeb238a be allowed to merge using real behavior proof captured on earlier head 58954a46c67c11b2027c10cfec236e9b2448f66b?
rationale: Later commits materially changed secrets publication ownership and restart-emission retry behavior, so repository policy requires exact-head external-PR proof unless a maintainer explicitly overrides that gate.

options.title: Require exact-head proof
options.body: Ask for redacted current-head runtime output covering successful channel deferral and a recovery-restart failure before merge.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Accept the earlier transcript plus current-head tests after direct maintainer review of the later lifecycle changes.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted current-head runtime output covering successful channel deferral and a recovery-restart failure before merge.
